# Minimal Data Studio 0.6.0
Configure external database connections once and reuse them across projects.
- Open **Connections…** in the Mac project manager to search, create, edit, duplicate, and test connections. - Add an existing connection to a project without copying its settings. Shared edits show the projects they affect. - Test sign-in and browsing access from the manager, with success/error status and guidance for MFA and Keychain approval. - Existing project connections migrate automatically while preserving saved query, notebook, and model references. - Removing a connection from a project keeps its central configuration. Missing connections require explicit reconnection.
Passwords remain in macOS Keychain; connection settings stay on this Mac. Project folders store connection links rather than account settings. Query and publishing permissions may differ from browsing access.
Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14 or newer. Includes Python and R. Save your work before installing; project data stays outside the app.
